basic_details.job_title: Sikkim High Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 6 IT Assistant, Developer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Sikkim High Court has announced 6 vacancies for Senior Technical Officer, Senior Developer, Developer and IT Assistant posts on a contract basis for a period of 1 (one) year under its 2026 recruitment drive. Eligible candidates must submit their offline applications by speed post to reach the Office of the Central Project Coordinator, High Court of Sikkim, Gangtok, or submit them in person on or before 20 November 2026. The notified monthly pay is Rs. 65,000 for Senior Technical Officer, Rs. 55,000 for Senior Developer, Rs. 50,000 for Developer, and Rs. 45,180 for IT Assistant, with qualificat

age_limit.details: Not less than 18 years of age as on the first day of January of the recruitment year i.e., 01.01.2026 and not more than 30 years of age on the last day of submission of Application Form. Relaxation of upper age limit shall be the same as may be prescribed by the State Government from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Sikkim High Court Senior Technical Officer at a Glance

rows.details: Senior Technical Officer, Senior Developer, Developer, IT Assistant
Degree in Computer Science / IT / Electronics or BCA / BSc / MCA / M.Sc

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications sent by speed post must reach the office of the Central Project Coordinator on or before 20 November 2026. Applications can also be submitted in the office of the Central Project Coordinator during office hours, latest by 20 November 2026 before 4:30 p.m.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc with specialization in Computer Science / Electronics / IT from a recognized institution with a minimum of 02 years experience in administration of IT Infrastructure, Networks, Database, Server Administration / LAN / Technical Troubleshooting & Supporting Hardware. BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc with specialization in Computer Science / Electronics / IT from a recognized institution with a minimum of 02 years experience in software development including application design, development, testing and maintenance. BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc with specialization in Computer Science / Electronics / IT from a recognized institution with a minimum of 01 year experience in software development. BE / B.Tech / BCA / BSc (IT / Computer Science). Not less than 18 years of age as on the first day of January of the recruitment year i.e., 01.01.2026 and not more than 30 years of age on the last day of submission of Application Form. Relaxation of upper age limit shall be the same as may be prescribed by the State Government from time to time. A candidate must be a citizen of India. No person who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or who having a spouse living has entered into or contracted a marriage with another person, shall be eligible for appointment as officer or staff of the High Court.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Birth Certificate, or Passport, or Certificate of Identification (only in case of Sikkim subjects), or Valid Voters' Identity Card issued by the Election Commission of India.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The examinations for the concerned posts will be held in the following manner viz., Written Examination, Practical Test, followed by Interview / viva-voce. Candidates securing 40% or more marks in the Written Examination shall be eligible to appear in the Practical Test. Candidates securing 40% or more marks in the Practical Test shall be eligible to appear in the Interview / Viva-Voce. Final selection will be made on the basis of the combined marks secured by the candidates in the Written Examination, Practical Test and Interview / viva-voce. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of over-all performance of the candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced in the Sikkim High Court recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies have been announced for Senior Technical Officer, Senior Developer, Developer, and IT Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form by speed post or in person is 20 November 2026 by 4:30 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly remuneration for Senior Technical Officer?
faq.answer: The monthly fixed remuneration for Senior Technical Officer is Rs. 65,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be less than 18 years as on 01.01.2026 and not more than 30 years of age on the last day of submission of application form, with upper age relaxation as per State Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The posts are on a purely contractual basis for a period of 1 (one) year under the e-Courts Project Phase-III.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Developer post?
faq.answer: Candidates need BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc with specialization in Computer Science / Electronics / IT from a recognized institution with a minimum of 01 year experience in software development.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection procedure for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Examination, a Practical Test, followed by an Interview / Viva-Voce.

faq.question: Q8. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by speed post or submitted in person to the Office of the Central Project Coordinator, High Court of Sikkim, Gangtok.

faq.question: Q9. What proof of citizenship is accepted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit a Birth Certificate, Passport, Certificate of Identification (for Sikkim subjects), or a valid Voters' Identity Card issued by the Election Commission of India.

faq.question: Q10. Are T.A. or D.A. paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No T.A. / D.A. shall be paid for appearing in the interview and viva-voce.
